metadata.title: MTG Unmapped / Synthetic Review Queue (Consolidated)
metadata.spec_section: §29 of MTG Fingertips → EKriti NCERT Topic Integration spec
metadata.description: Per spec §29, every question that cannot be cleanly mapped is kept here. NO question is silently dropped, randomly assigned, or hidden from the report. Two classes of records: (a) questions already in repair queues from prior audits; (b) questions flagged as SUSPECTED_SYNTHETIC in the exam scorer audit — these are DB rows whose metadata matches a canonical source slot but whose question text was generated synthetically and must be replaced with authentic source content from the MTG PDFs.

synthetic_in_app.explanation: These 11,649 records have valid chapter/topic metadata in the application but their question text is suspected-synthetic (placeholder) and must be replaced with authentic source text from the MTG Fingertips PDFs. The full canonical source (13,750 questions) is referenced in docs/MTG_AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_INVENTORY.json but only 2,466 of those questions have verbatim content in docs/MTG_SOURCE_MASTER_MANIFEST.json. The remaining ~11,284 source questions need to be re-extracted from the PDFs (per spec §33 this is normally forbidden, but the canonical source JSON in repo is incomplete — see docs/MTG_INTEGRATION.md §5 for the extraction plan).
